subject: Biology
why: The live database holds 106 Biology topics, most of them phrasing variants of the same concept, created by the import auto-creating a topic from whatever text a CSV carried (SABI-REV-025). Grouping new questions against them would split one concept across several buckets. This file proposes 26 canonical topics aligned to the WAEC and JAMB Biology syllabus, and maps every existing topic onto one of them. Nothing in the database is changed by this file.

canonical.name: Characteristics and Classification of Living Things
canonical.covers: features of life, levels of organisation, taxonomy, kingdoms, diversity

canonical.name: Cell Structure and Function
canonical.covers: plant and animal cells, organelles, cell theory

canonical.name: Cell Division
canonical.covers: mitosis, meiosis and their stages

canonical.name: Movement of Substances
